## Automated gate

Command: `WSCRPT_REQUIRE_TMUX=1 scripts/verify.sh`

The gate was run outside the restricted filesystem sandbox so the isolated tmux server could create its socket. The same required run inside the sandbox correctly failed with `Operation not permitted`; it was not counted as a pass.

- Documentation tests: 3 passed.
